title: Noir Precision
description: Lean, tense narration that observes people with unsentimental clarity and keeps emotional revelations compressed until they matter.
technical_guide: Favor exact sensory detail, short-to-medium sentences, and understated emotional inference. Let danger register through implication before declaration. Keep exposition sparse and pressure every paragraph toward suspicion, leverage, or exposure.
example: The room looked borrowed from a better life: clean lamp, crooked frame, one chair too carefully placed. He stood in the doorway like someone measuring the distance to his next mistake.
blacklist: Over-explaining character motives before the scene earns it
pacing_bias: slow burn until leverage shifts, then accelerate sharply
